# Traceability matrix

<!-- Generated by `make traceability` (go run ./cmd/tools/traceability): do not edit by hand. -->

Every feature of the [catalog](../docs/02-features.md) with the tests that cover it ([06 §6.8](../docs/06-test-plan.md#68-traceability-matrix)): a test declares the features it verifies with a `covers: <code>` tag in a comment (Go tests, `testscript` scripts in `test/cli`, Vitest and Playwright tests in `web/`, test scripts). The grouped codes of the catalog (`D-ACC-01..04`, `D-CCH-01..08`, `D-DST-01..08`) are expanded with the descriptions of [10](../docs/10-domains-access-distributions.md) and [11](../docs/11-domain-cache.md). The `internal/tools/traceability` test fails if a P0/P1 feature has no test, if a tag names a code outside the catalog or if this file is stale.

## Summary

| Priority | Features | With tests | Without tests |
|----------|---------:|-----------:|--------------:|
| P0 | 75 | 75 | 0 |
| P1 | 73 | 73 | 0 |
| P2 (not in v1.0) | 17 | 1 | — |

A feature with a mixed priority (`P0/P1`, `P1 / P2`) is in the scope of v1.0 for its P0/P1 part and is counted with the highest priority.
